property.name: http.agent.name
property.description: HTTP agent name identifying the Eesha Search crawler. Must be set; otherwise Nutch refuses to start crawling.

property.name: http.agent.description
property.description: Descriptive text for the crawler user-agent.

property.name: http.agent.url
property.description: URL where webmasters can learn about this crawler.

property.name: http.agent.email
property.description: Contact email for the crawler.

property.name: plugin.includes
property.description: Regular expression naming plugin directories to include. Covers HTTP fetching, HTML parsing, meta-tag extraction, OpenSearch indexing, OPIC scoring, and URL normalization.

property.name: opensearch.server.url
property.description: OpenSearch cluster endpoint inside the Docker network.

property.name: opensearch.index
property.description: Name of the OpenSearch index to write documents into.

property.name: opensearch.max.docs
property.description: Maximum number of documents per batch (-1 = unlimited).

property.name: metatags.names
property.description: HTML meta-tag names to extract during parsing. Used by the parse-metatags plugin for image/video discovery.

property.name: parser.html.impl
property.description: HTML parser implementation (neko is the default).

property.name: fetcher.threads.fetch
property.description: Number of fetcher threads per task.

property.name: fetcher.threads.per.queue
property.description: Number of fetcher threads per host queue.

property.name: fetcher.server.delay
property.description: Minimum delay (seconds) between successive requests to the same server. Respects politeness.

property.name: db.fetch.interval.default
property.description: Default re-fetch interval in seconds (21600 = 6 hours). Pages will be re-crawled every 6 hours by default.

property.name: db.max.outlinks.per.page
property.description: Maximum number of outlinks to follow per page. Limits crawl breadth while preserving depth.

property.name: db.fetch.schedule.adaptive.sync_rate
property.description: Sync rate for adaptive fetch schedule.

property.name: http.content.limit
property.description: Maximum content length (bytes) to fetch. Pages larger than 64 KB are truncated.

property.name: file.content.ignored
property.description: Ignore file:// URLs entirely. We only crawl HTTP/HTTPS.

property.name: parser.character.encoding.default
property.description: Default character encoding when not specified by the server.

property.name: parser.timeout
property.description: Parser timeout in seconds.

property.name: urlfilter.regex.file
property.description: Name of the regex URL filter file.

property.name: urlfilter.automaton.file
property.description: Name of the automaton URL filter file.
